people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

people.name: Nebuchadnezzar
people.line: Emperor of Babylon who conquered Judah

translations.web: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face, worshiped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an offering and sweet odors to him.
translations.bsb: At this, King Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face, paid homage to Daniel, and ordered that an offering and incense be presented to him.
translations.kjv: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and worshipped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours
translations.asv: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and worshipped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odors unto him.
